_readme: Control-plane configuration for scripts/run_round.py. rotation_key points into rotation.json; enabled=false documents exhausted or policy-blocked veins without deleting their resumable state; required=false keeps a volatile finder visible while allowing healthy veins to complete when it reports an outage, and a failed rotating finder retains its pointer.
